profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Engineering Manager | Leading Data-Driven Solutions in Cognitive Science
profile.summary:
Coding is an art form, and I’ve never met an art form I didn’t want to master.

I've always found beauty in creative disciplines, from photography and music to illustration and software engineering. That curiosity drives me to understand how things work, challenge conventional approaches, and find creative solutions to complex problems.

But experience has taught me that great engineering is about more than writing great code.

As a Principal Software Engineer and Engineering Manager, I've learned to approach engineering decisions with the bigger picture in mind, balancing development time, cost, security, maintainability, and stakeholder needs. I believe the best solutions aren't necessarily the most sophisticated, but those that deliver meaningful results while remaining sustainable.

My experience spans software architecture, research data infrastructure, machine learning, and advanced statistical analysis. I've developed systems that streamline research workflows, improve data quality, and make complex information more accessible. My contributions to peer-reviewed research have reinforced the importance of data integrity, reproducibility, and translating technical findings into meaningful insights.

I believe the best systems are built by teams that are empowered to grow.

Leadership isn't about being the most knowledgeable person in the room. It's about building an environment where knowledge is shared, communication is clear, and people feel confident challenging ideas and taking ownership of their work (even their mistakes).

I've established collaborative development practices, mentorship structures, and workflows that align engineering decisions with organizational goals while creating opportunities for professional growth. I take pride in helping my team develop skills that may eventually surpass my own.

I hold a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Colorado Boulder, but learning remains central to how I work. From emerging technologies and AI integrations to evolving engineering practices, I'm constantly looking for ways to improve both the systems we build and how we build them.

At heart, I still see engineering as a creative craft. And there is a certain beauty to the art of solving the right problem, respecting genuine constraints, and leaving both the system and the people behind it better than before.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer & Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Lead advanced research computing, data engineering, and analytical initiatives supporting multidisciplinary biomedical research, combining software engineering leadership with machine learning, statistical analysis, and research data infrastructure.
 • Contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of machine learning and advanced statistical analyses, supporting peer-reviewed research publications and the investigation of complex biomedical outcomes.
 • Lead large-scale research data harmonization efforts, integrating heterogeneous datasets across studies while validating consistency with previously published analyses and maintaining reproducibility.
 • Direct the development of research data platforms and analytical tools that improve data accessibility, transparency, and usability, enabling researchers to explore existing findings and formulate new research questions.
 • Oversee engineering practices for systems handling sensitive research data, emphasizing data integrity, secure access, reliability, and quality assurance.
 • Provide technical leadership across software engineering and research teams, translating complex analytical requirements into maintainable infrastructure and reproducible computational workflows.
positions.insights: Data Science, Python (Programming Language) and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Led a multidisciplinary software engineering team responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining research applications and data management infrastructure supporting biomedical research.
 • Architected and developed custom web applications, automated workflows, and data processing systems to streamline laboratory operations, improve data quality, and reduce manual administrative work.
 • Managed the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
 • Recruited, trained, and mentored undergraduate software developers, establishing coding standards, object-oriented design practices, and structured onboarding processes.
 • Collaborated with researchers and laboratory leadership to translate complex scientific and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
 • Directed engineering priorities, resource allocation, and project timelines while balancing research deadlines, system reliability, and evolving laboratory needs.

positions.title: Data Management Team Lead
positions.description:
Collaborated with cross-disciplinary research teams to build adaptive multi-framework data management solutions.
Enabled agile development, by building rapid Python prototypes and digital UX/UI wireframes in Adobe Illustrator for quick feedback from research staff.
Successfully decreased data collection errors by 300% through automating quality checks with a Flask x MongoDB web application using Pandas for data cleaning and visualization.

positions.title: Research & Development Head
positions.description: Organised and managed project teams which involves fostering collaborations and feedback. Conducted empathy interviews with families of visually impaired children. Conducted training for interns to develop 3D printed designs for tactile learning experiences.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Developed a work schedule for all technicians using Excel. Assisted teachers and students with on campus computer issues. Managed the help desk and took calls assisting students with their login issues

positions.title: Partnership
positions.description: Designed an Android game capable of helping people learn a location before going and visiting it. Managed deadlines ensuring that we finished before deadline and presented in the 2012  DEMOGala convention.

publications.title: Accuracy of labeled THC potency across flower and concentrate cannabis products
The transformation of a gold standard in-person substance use assessment to a web-based, REDCap integrated data capture tool
